observations: Run 3 baseline was prepared in a dedicated evidence directory before attempting GUI actions.
The isolated VS Code window initially displayed a browser page and a Copilot Chat context chip for Client Showcase - Agent Skills; this was not an acceptable clean context for the fixed case.

The GUI automation repeatedly failed to create and visually verify a fresh chat. The title-bar plus opened a menu; the task agent's subsequent selection was not reliably reflected in the final screenshot.
A Command+N attempt did not create a Copilot chat and opened or switched to a separate Welcome Code window; no further action was taken on that window.
The Agent Host log records two deferred chat creations/removals but contains no sendMessage, research-material-writer invocation, tool call, or final response for this attempt.
The test repository remained clean and temporary keybindings were absent.
decision: Do not create run.json and do not count this attempt toward the required first three C01 runs. Restore a reliable way to create a fresh isolated Copilot chat without inherited browser/page context before starting C01 run-3.
